# SBML test suite

Semantic test cases of the [SBML test suite](https://github.com/sbmlteam/sbml-test-suite) 3.5.0, run with sbml2cellml 0.1.0. Every case is simulated with roadrunner (`reference`), converted to CellML (`sbml2cellml`), simulated with libopencor (`libopencor`), converted back to SBML (`cellml2sbml`) and simulated with roadrunner again (`roundtrip`); every simulation is compared with the expected results using the tolerances of the case. See [Development](development.md#sbml-test-suite) for how to run it.
